icons: Real, locally bundled brand images; AQUA alias resolves Aquarius, SolvBTC image acquired through Chrome. Source URLs and hashes in logo-provenance.json.
vaults: USDC and XLM retained; six requested assets added. Checkbox + icon + symbol in a compact two-column grid. Filters combine and reset; no matching fixture produces an empty state, not a fabricated vault.
trade: Searchable native modal for Pay and Receive, also opened from the pair heading. Selecting the other side swaps both assets to prevent an identical pair. Escape/Close restores focus.
quotes: Every asset or direction change clears amounts, minimum received and review metadata. Only the original XLM/USDC fixture supports a sample quote. Other pairs show unavailable prices/history/routes and disable review until market data is integrated.
chart_lifecycle: Chart interval listeners and resize observer are disposed before a new pair mounts. Restoring the original pair restores its OHLC fixture without duplicate handlers.
production: Catalog entries must bind canonical network/issuer/SAC/contract and decimals; source availability, wallet eligibility and amount-specific routing are checked independently before review.
